comparison: CHAP 2025 1km population-weighted county proxy versus official 2025 county annual PM2.5 figures
interpretation: CHAP estimates are higher than official county annual values for all 19 matched Fujian candidates (mean difference about 4.1 µg/m³; correlation is weakly negative). This is a material cross-source discrepancy, not proof that either source is wrong because the spatial aggregation and modelling methods differ. Keep CHAP as a screening layer only; do not use it alone for formal exclusion or grading. Cross-check source definitions, spatial footprints and official monitoring data.
limitations: CHAP is a model-derived 1km surface aggregated with WorldPop 2024 weights.
Official figures are county-level annual values; exact spatial footprints and monitoring aggregation may differ.
Only 19 of the 236 candidates have this matched official comparison in the current evidence.
